note: Per-lane minimum scorecard-passed counts. The evidence gates fail a lane when its count of genuine pixel-scorecard passes (scores/<stem>.json with status pass, pctAAMasked<=5, compositionOk) drops below its floor — honesty cannot decay. Raise a floor when a new stem genuinely passes; never lower one without owner sign-off. first-party/mui have no pixel scorecards yet (attested-only lanes), so their floors are 0.
